title: Single-Instance Override Component Must Not Inherit Recurrence Rule or Exception Properties

citations.verbatim_quote: If present, this JSCalendar object represents one occurrence of a recurring JSCalendar object. If present, the "recurrenceRules" and "recurrenceOverrides" properties MUST NOT be present.

A pointer in the PatchObject MUST be ignored if it starts with one of the following prefixes:

   *  @type

   *  excludedRecurrenceRules

   *  method

   *  privacy

   *  prodId

   *  recurrenceId

   *  recurrenceIdTimeZone

   *  recurrenceOverrides

   *  recurrenceRules

A VEVENT (or VTODO) component is a recurrence override if it has the RECURRENCE-ID property set, and the iCalendar object contains a VEVENT (or VTODO) component that does not have the RECURRENCE-ID but the RRULE property set, and the UID property values of the two components are equal. The component without the RECURRENCE-ID property is in that case referred to as the "main component".

rationale: Per RFC 8984 Section 4.3.1, an object with `recurrenceId` represents a single occurrence of a recurring object and MUST NOT have `recurrenceRules` (RRULE) or `recurrenceOverrides` (RDATE, EXDATE). Likewise, RFC 8984 Section 4.3.5 specifies that pointers in `recurrenceOverrides` patches to `recurrenceRules`, `excludedRecurrenceRules`, or `recurrenceOverrides` MUST be ignored. If a single-instance override component in iCalendar inherits RRULE, RDATE, or EXDATE from the master component, the override component itself is erroneously treated as a recurring series (when RRULE or RDATE is present) or illegally carries series-level RDATE/EXDATE properties.
store_implication: When a single-instance edit forks an override component from a recurring master component, the calendar store MUST clear RRULE, RDATE, and EXDATE on the override component. The override component MUST represent a single non-recurring instance and MUST NOT carry over any EXDATE or RDATE entries from the master series.
edge_cases_and_counterexamples: Master component has RDATE=['2025-05-10T09:00:00']: editing the May 3 instance as a single instance MUST clear RDATE on the override component; otherwise the override component would itself be treated as a recurring series and expand multiple times on the timeline.

Master component has EXDATE=['2025-05-02T09:00:00'] and no RDATE: editing the May 3 instance as a single instance MUST clear EXDATE on the override component even when the override has no RRULE or RDATE.

scenarios.name: single_instance_override_clears_rrule_rdate_and_exdate
scenarios.description: Creating a single-instance override on a master series that has both EXDATE and RDATE clears rrule, rdate, and exdate on the override component.
